lines: Yaad nahin
Yaad nahin kya kya dekha tha, saare manzar bhool gaye
couplets.en: I cannot recall all that I saw, for every scene has faded.

lines: Yaad nahin kya kya dekha tha, saare manzar bhool gaye

lines: Yaad nahin kya kya dekha tha, saare manzar bhool gaye

lines: Yaad nahin kya kya dekha tha, saare manzar bhool gaye
Uski galiyon se jab laute, apna bhi ghar bhool gaye
couplets.en: Every scene slipped from memory, and by the time I came back from her lanes, I had forgotten even my own home.

lines: Yaad nahin, yaad nahin
Khoob gaye pardes ke apne deewaar-o-dar bhool gaye
couplets.en: We went so far from home that we forgot our own walls and doors.

lines: Khoob gaye pardes ke apne deewaar-o-dar bhool gaye
Sheesh mahal ne aisa ghera, mitti ke ghar bhool gaye
couplets.en: We went so far from home that we forgot our own walls and doors, and the palace of mirrors made us forget our earthen houses.

lines: Uski galiyon se jab laute, apna bhi ghar bhool gaye
couplets.en: By the time I came back from her lanes, I had forgotten even my own home.

lines: Yaad nahin, yaad nahin
Tujhko bhi jab apni qasmen, apne waade yaad nahin
couplets.en: Even you no longer remember your vows and promises.

lines: Tujhko bhi jab apni qasmen, apne waade yaad nahin
Hum bhi apne khwaab teri aankhon mein rakh kar bhool gaye
couplets.en: When you forgot your vows and promises, I too left my dreams in your eyes and forgot them there.

lines: Uski galiyon se jab laute, apna bhi ghar bhool gaye
couplets.en: By the time I came back from her lanes, I had forgotten even my own home.

lines: Yaad nahin, yaad nahin
Mujhko jinhon ne qatl kiya hai, koi unhen batlaaye, Nazeer
couplets.en: Nazeer, someone should tell those who killed me.

lines: Mujhko jinhon ne qatl kiya hai, koi unhen batlaaye, Nazeer
Meri laash ke pehlu mein woh apna khanjar bhool gaye
couplets.en: Nazeer, someone should tell my killers they left their dagger beside my body.
